question: Which country became the first in Africa to be acknowledged by the World Health Organization (WHO) for eliminating onchocerciasis (river blindness) in early 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Niger**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Niger** became the** first African country** to be acknowledged by the World Health Organization (WHO) for successfully eliminating **onchocerciasis (river blindness)** in early 2025.
 
• The WHO recognition came after Niger conducted extensive public health campaigns aimed at eradicating the disease, which is caused by the parasitic worm **Onchocerca volvulus**.
